title: 1935 National Chicle Knute Rockne Green Bay Packers Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1935 National Chicle Gum Reprint trading card features Knute Rockne, a legendary football player from the Green Bay Packers. The card is a part of the 1935 National Chicle set and is perfect for collectors who are looking to add a piece of history to their collection. 

The card is in great shape and has been well-preserved, making it a valuable addition to any sports trading card collection. It is a must-have for fans of the NFL and Knute Rockne. This trading card is a great way to remember the rich history of football and the Green Bay Packers.
